WITH product_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        pc.product_type_description,
        AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS order_item_count
    FROM Products AS p
    JOIN Product_Categories AS pc
      ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi
      ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT
        product_type_description,
        average_quantity,
        order_item_count,
        CAST(order_item_count AS DECIMAL(19,4))
          / SUM(order_item_count) OVER () AS order_item_share
    FROM product_metrics
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT
        product_type_description,
        AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity,
        AVG(order_item_count) AS average_order_item_count,
        AVG(order_item_share) AS average_order_item_share
    FROM product_shares
    GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT
    AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity,
    AVG(average_order_item_count) AS average_order_item_count,
    AVG(average_order_item_share) AS average_share
FROM type_averages

assumptions.assumption: `product_quantity` contains numeric text (or NULL), so it can be cast to a decimal for averaging.
